violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
Strawberries were observed adulterated with black residue. PIC voluntarily disposed of at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC voluntarily disposed of at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Several items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The presence of insects is not controlled as evidenced by dead insects on fly tape. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Fly tape was observed hanging in the kitchen. Insect control devices shall be installed and located so that dead insects or insect fragments cannot contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, or single-service and single-use articles. Relocate the fly strip to an appropriate location away from food preparation, warewashing, and clean equipment storage areas. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler shelving have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

Cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025
Drinks were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the chest freezer and bar cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2025

Hamburgers are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2024
